planning.method: Deterministic Panda IK, sampled joint transit and straight approach/lift; no detour search
planning.closing_control: Command zero jaw gap; existing 20 N per-finger actuator effort limit and physical contacts determine actual gap.
planning.candidate_prefilter: Known width and approach direction before ranking eligible candidates; at most 200 eligible candidates, 400 generated total, unchanged 30 s budget

physics.robot_gravity: Isaac native high-PD gravity disabled; MuJoCo robot gravcomp=1
physics.calibration_adjustment: Before main experiments, nominal centered-box calibration showed 5.11 mm endpoint lag despite successful lift. Add one second at the approach endpoint in both new platforms; retain the original 2 mm endpoint criterion and the failed v1 calibration.

failure_policy: Keep algorithm failures and timeouts; no success-based retries. Infrastructure failures retain attempt IDs and require diagnosis before retry. Do not launch main physics before platform calibration passes.

dataset.name: public_cad_main_v1
dataset.selection: Every registered scene in this batch

evaluation.oracle_pose: evaluation-only; not used in candidate generation or planning

cad_input.cad_fused: Known identity and CAD; estimated pose from FoundationStereo observations only

purpose: Frozen v6 physical and perception settings; task profile supplied by prepare_experiment.py
control_provenance: Zero-gap force-limited closure fixed using the previous CAD development pilot, before rendering this cohort; identical for all methods. No adaptation to new evaluation outcomes.

failure_handling.point_cloud_failure: Keep the scheduled scene. Save an explicitly labelled empty output and the failure record; never fabricate valid depth or points.
failure_handling.upstream_failure: Failed forward perception affects both arms. Failed reverse inference or fusion affects the CAD arm. No automatic retry or outcome-based fallback for a timeout.
failure_handling.candidate_failure: A deadline or invalid pose/score output produces zero executable candidates and remains a failed scheduled task on all platforms.
failure_handling.numerical_output: Preserve available invalid candidate arrays and the exception record.
failure_handling.unknown_error: Unhandled runtime errors, process termination, missing or mismatched files and resource failures stop the worker with the task pending; classify the retained evidence before restoring the same input.
failure_handling.native_call_deadline: POSIX alarm plus elapsed-time check discards late results. A native call that never returns remains pending until supervised termination is diagnosed; no claim of hard real-time process interruption.
failure_handling.retry_policy: No success-based retries. Infrastructure recovery must keep the attempt and verify frozen inputs, models, code, protocol and task identity.

workcell.design: Same scene geometry for both methods and engines. The table and bin fit original-size CAD objects; distractors stay outside the declared pickup ROI. Placement seeds are those already registered in scene_index.json. Scene truth is saved only under scene_specs/evaluation.

release_note: prepare_experiment.py registers the actual profile, per-task seeds and platform dispatch from RQ2/data/paper_final_20261019/selection.json
